stockNotice.title: About stock balances
stockNotice.body: A stock balance is a position held with this platform that tracks the share price. It is not ownership of the company's shares, and no third party holds shares behind it. It pays no dividends and cannot be transferred out — sell it here to convert it back to the quote asset.

kindBreakdown.title: Cash by asset type
kindBreakdown.note: Cash only — available plus frozen balances, valued in USDT. Position margin, unrealized PnL, Earn and Quant Fund are excluded, so these four add up to less than your total assets.
